messages:
maria-support: OakGrove reported a sharp p99 jump on generation calls starting ~2026-02-10T14:00Z. p95 ~420ms, p99 spiking to 3.2s+. Customer says UX times out. Example request-id: rq_113fa9c2. Seen across both hosted and dedicated? customer on hosted.

anna-cs: Thanks — can you paste a couple of raw timing headers / request-ids? I'll ask them for repro steps.

maria-support: Got two request IDs from the customer: rq_113fa9c2, rq_113fb0e7. They sent a small prompt (single-turn) using model redwood-open-3b with max_tokens=512.

mike-oncall: Looking at router metrics — there's a cluster of long tails originating from host pool gpu-pool-7 between 13:55-14:30Z. Correlated with higher KV cache evictions and >1MB kv-reloads per request. Might be warm/cold cache churn.

anna-cs: Repro attempt? maria — can you ask OakGrove for a minimal curl we can run (anon key ok) so eng can reproduce locally?

maria-support: Sent. Customer provided this repro curl:

```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-oakgrove-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-3b","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```

mike-oncall: Thanks. I replayed a couple of requests against a probe node; single request occasionally hits 2.8s when the backend does a full kv-cache reload. Pattern: long-context jobs from another tenant evict large KV segments and cause reload for OakGrove (noisy neighbor).

Tess-engineering: Re: mitigation options: 1) Tenant reservation to isolate OakGrove on a small dedicated slice (fast). 2) Soft throttle / per-tenant concurrency cap (immediate, lower risk). 3) Route OakGrove to a lighter quantized variant (open-3b-int8) while we stabilize. Also fix: reduce per-request max_kv_window for long sequences and enable prefix caching for their workload.

maria-support: Customer asked for a quick fix — prefers no code change. They want something we can flip on our side.

mike-oncall: I'll provision a temporary reservation in the isolated pool for 24h and put a soft concurrency cap at 6 for OakGrove. That should stop KV churn affecting their p99.

sre-bot: [action] create-reservation tenant=oakgrove pool=isolated-burst duration=86400 -> job 389271 queued
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: apply-tenant-quota-389271 to routing on gpu-pool-7 at 1765433400

anna-cs: What about routing them to the quantized variant? That reduces memory pressure. Could be second line if reservation isn't enough.

Tess-engineering: If reservation + concurrency cap doesn't fully mitigate, we'll flip routing to redwood-open-3b-int8 for their tenant. To do that internally: 

```
POST /internal/admin/tenants/oakgrove/route
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "target_model": "redwood-open-3b-int8",
  "reason": "temporary tail mitigation",
  "ttl_seconds": 86400
}
```

mike-oncall: Executed reservation and soft cap at 14:30Z (applied to isolated-burst). Initial telemetry: p99 dropped from 3.2s -> ~480ms within 3 mins. p95 stayed ~420ms.

maria-support: Customer confirms improvement on their end, UX responsive again. They saw 95% reduction in timeouts. :tada:

Tess-engineering: We'll still investigate root cause: presumption is noisy neighbor with long-sequence KV eviction. Plan: increase isolation heuristics in the scheduler (do not co-locate long-kv tenants on same slice), patch in tighter KV cache eviction prioritization, and add per-tenant KV size caps.

mike-oncall: I've created internal ticket INF-5409 to track follow-ups and schedule a canary for scheduler heuristic change.

maria-support: Follow-up action for CS — offer OakGrove 48h of reserved capacity at no charge while we stabilize, and share our recommended client-side changes (reduce max_tokens where possible, reuse sessions). I sent the note.

anna-cs: Nice. For the record, logs we collected for rq_113fa9c2: 

```
[router] 2026-02-10T14:07:12Z rq_113fa9c2 latency=3120ms backend=serving-32 kv_reload=true evicted_segments=3
[serving-32] 2026-02-10T14:07:11Z load_kv start size=1.2MB
[serving-32] 2026-02-10T14:07:12Z load_kv ok
```

Tess-engineering: Good logs. For post-mortem I'd like to collect a 6hr window of KV eviction rate per pool and tenant. mike, can you attach those to INF-5409?

mike-oncall: On it. I'll add graphs and host-level traces.

maria-support: Closing here — temporary reservation applied, customer happy, follow-up ticket created. Will reopen if p99 resurges.

maria-support: cc @anna-cs @tess-engineering @mike-oncall — marking resolved, will update INF-5409 with final post-mortem when done. :white_check_mark:
